title: They Don't Know
label: Independiente / Relentless

type.basis: Album: the Quietus (2020) hears grime avant la lettre in tracks such as Deeper. Multi-track items are not coded as one profile.

sound.text: The Quietus (2020) hears a maximal record of sub bass, distorted synth lines and serrated drum hits, with drums drawing on dancehall, 2-step, house and hip hop.
The Quietus singles out 'Deeper' (two-step beat, bass thump; 'grime avant la lettre') and 'In My Life' (metallic bass recalling early dubstep).
Vice (2017) describes 'a raw and forward-facing futurism' and calls the title track a blend of ragga, garage beats, clipped delivery and R&B.

context.text: Official Albums Chart peak no. 6 (first chart date 1 Dec 2001, 23 weeks). The title-track single reached no. 3 (17 Nov 2001) and no. 1 on the Dance chart.
Certified Platinum by the BPI, per Wikipedia.
Vice (2017) frames So Solid as active before grime had a formal identity, in the gap between UKG's peak and grime's birth.
